title: Module comparison and action for the closed-fibre colimit
statement: Let R be local and let X be a Noetherian local model tower over R to S to Sprime with compatible Sprime and S actions on M [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower]. For its fixed explicit functors B,D, stage actions and induced psi [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-system], there exists a colimit B-module action on colimit D whose coprojections are semilinear, and an additive equivalence eD from colimit D to (S/m_R S) tensor over S with M intertwining the action restricted along psi with the scalar action via the fixed canonical ring equivalence fiberAEquiv [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-ring-colimit]. The ring comparison is already constructed and proved; Uniqueness of the action is proved by the parent colimit theorem. No flatness is assumed.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00R7, paragraph beginning with the colimit of the maximal ideals, quotient systems before the second use of Tag 00R6; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R7.

proof.text:
First derive S_i-semilinearity of nmap and nlimit from their T_i
semilinearity and the commuting middle-to-top squares. The images of the
submodules m_i N_i form an S-submodule of M: move summands and scalars to a
common stage using directedness and slimit_surj. It contains m_R M: the proved
fiberIdealS_limit_rep represents each coefficient in m_R S at a stage, and
nlimit_surj represents each module element. Thus every element of m_R M has
a stage representative in m_i N_i. Using nlimit_eq at a further stage proves
that a stage element killed in M/m_R M is killed in its later stage quotient.

Identify each fiberD_i with N_i/m_i N_i using fiberDEquiv and
quotTensorEquivQuotSMul. Descend nlimit to an additive map from this quotient
to M/m_R M. Its formula on pure tensors and the original nlimit_comm make
these maps a cocone. Surjectivity follows from nlimit_surj. The eventual-zero
result, applied to differences, proves eventual equality. The types filtered
colimit criterion and reflection by forget AddCommGrpCat identify this cocone
as a group colimit. Compose the colimit comparison with the inverse of
quotTensorEquivQuotSMul for S/m_R S to construct fiberDLimitEquiv.

Construct the ring cocone from fiberB to S'/m_R S' by descending its limit
maps, and let fiberBDesc be its universal ring homomorphism from colimit B.
No assertion that this ring cocone is a colimit is needed. The equivalence
between the top quotient tensor module and M/m_R M follows by restricting
the top ideal-times-module quotient to S and using Ideal.smul_restrictScalars.
Transport its module action to M/m_R M, restrict along fiberBDesc, and transport
across the proved additive colimit comparison to define the required action.
The quotient formula mk(b) acting on mk(m) equals mk(b acting on m); applying
it to pure tensors proves coprojection semilinearity using nlimit_smul.

Finally represent any colimit-A scalar at a stage and any quotient module
element by an element of M. The coprojection formula for fiberPsi and
st_limit_comm identify its image under fiberBDesc with the image of the
canonical fiberAEquiv in the top quotient. The quotient action formula,
algebraMap_smul, and S-linearity of the tensor-quotient equivalence give the
asserted scalar compatibility. Package this action and fiberDLimitEquiv.
All data are explicit or obtained from a proved universal property; no
flatness, tlimit_surj or tlimit_eq is used.

proof_origin.note: Complete quotient-group colimit proof and explicitly transported scalar action. No remaining sorry and no top-ring colimit equivalence needed.

mathlib_searches.query: quotients of a directed system of rings form a directed system whose colimit is the quotient ring
A directed system of local ring quotients and modules has colimit the quotient by the maximal ideal
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.directLimitIsColimit and related fixed-ring direct-limit declarations; no closed-fibre tower diagram match. Loogle tensor-equivalence search also found TensorProduct.comm, LinearEquiv.lTensor/rTensor and equivOfCompatibleSMul.

Found Ideal.quotientMap, Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom, IsLocalization.of_surjective, quotTensorEquivQuotSMul, Ideal.smul_restrictScalars and AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange. None states the tower-specific assertion; these prove its stage constructions and localization comparison. Blueprint searches closed fibre colimit and quotient localization tensor each returned zero matches.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no exact match; general APIs used

lean.statement: theorem NoetherianLocalModelTower.fiber_module_colimit {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {S' : Type w} {M : Type t} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Module S' M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S S' M] (X : NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M) : letI := X.preorder letI := X.commR letI := X.commS letI := X.localR letI := X.algRS letI := X.addN letI := X.moduleS let B := X.fiberB let D := X.fiberD letI := X.fiberAct let ψ := X.fiberψ ∃ limitAct : Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t}), letI := limitAct (∀ (i : X.ι) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i), (colimit.ι D i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι D i).hom x) ∧ (∃ (eD : (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t}) ≃+ ((S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) ⊗[S] M)), letI := Module.compHom (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t}) ψ ∀ a x, eD (a • x) = X.fiberAEquiv a • eD x)
